goalbuddy_receipt_v1.rationale: The revision is safe as one vertical slice with two tightened rules: candidates are visible leaf-most selectable descendants, and ordinary unarmed background movement above 4px preserves selection while suppressing its successor click. Hold-M activation, Shift captured at pointerdown, release/blur/hidden cancellation, frozen-scope search, full-union normalization, and cross-parent inspection fit existing seams. Modified M, editable/modal/composing/repeated keys never arm. Same-parent operation gates and primary-only handles prevent generalized multi-object transforms.

evidence.proof: Arm only fresh physical KeyM with no Cmd/Ctrl/Alt outside editable, modal, or composing contexts; Shift allowed; M remains held through commit.
Below 4px remains background click; at or above 4px is inert and suppresses successor click.
Eligibility is visible leaf-most descendants before viewport hit testing; locked visible leaves remain eligible.

One primary handle; mutation controls and same-parent operations remain gated; no collective transforms.
